periods.label: 小丑指挥前夜祭
periods.affiliation: Akatsuki Academy; Bunkyoku Academy cover; Rebellion-linked operation

status.current: survives the pre-festival attack and withdraws Akatsuki when Nene arrives

personality.summary: Flippant, theatrical and calculating; acts as the operation's announcer and practical coordinator.

relationships.nagi-arisuin: Communicates with Alice for Akatsuki, praises his usefulness, then carries him to Wallenstein after the failed betrayal.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Relies on Amane to coordinate Akatsuki temporarily when absent.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Orders withdrawal rather than risk the group against her.

periods.summary: Reisen appears as the clown-like Akatsuki coordinator. He calls Alice after Kagami is silenced, explains that Akatsuki's exact membership need not be shared before the festival, and later publicly introduces Akatsuki at the burning Hagun campus. During the counter-trap, his Black Widow strings manipulate Sara's fake dolls while Ouma hides the real members. He carries captured Alice back to Wallenstein, then returns and calls off the chase once Nene Saikyo protects Stella and the Hagure sisters, judging the risk too high before Seven Stars.

key_events.summary: Coordinates with Alice after Kagami's discovery.
Uses strings and dolls as part of the counter-ambush and extracts Alice.
Orders Akatsuki's withdrawal before fighting Nene.

periods.label: 小丑接受围攻红莲皇女

status.current: accepts Stella's special four-on-one match as a convenient chance to eliminate her

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Would have met Rinna in B-block round two, likely arranging an Akatsuki withdrawal without a real fight.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Treats Stella's self-imposed penalty as amusing and advantageous.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: One of the Akatsuki pieces used in Tsukikage's tournament plan.

periods.summary: Reisen enters the volume at the end, when Stella proposes that all remaining B-block fighters join her delayed first-round match as punishment for her tardiness. He laughs at the opportunity and accepts, recognizing that Stella has given Akatsuki a favorable chance to remove a major threat. Stella's actual motive is to stop Akatsuki members such as Reisen and Rinna from arranging noncompetitive withdrawals in later rounds.

key_events.summary: Accepts Stella's four-on-one challenge from the audience.
